compiled_state.title: [CI review gate]: PRs merged since LiteLLM epic shipped without passing code review -> retroactive review required for all merges from PR #49 onward
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
### 1. Technical Environment

* **code_version:** 5e49359669

### 2. Incident Overview

* **Scenario Type:** User-Flagged Behavior

#### Expected Behavior

Per CLAUDE.md Critical Rules #8: "Never manually call record-review.sh" and the review gate requires a passing review before any merge. All PRs merged to main must pass the LLM code review gate before merge.

#### Actual Behavior

The LiteLLM epic (PR #49 and all subsequent merges) shipped to main without functional CI review. The dso_ci_review module failed with ModuleNotFoundError: No module named 'litellm' on every run (bug b38d-1781), meaning the review gate was broken/bypassed for an unknown number of merges. All PRs merged since the LiteLLM epic shipped (PR #49 onward) require retroactive review: each merge must be reviewed and any critical/important findings remediated until a review passes.

### 3. Action History

* User explicitly requested retroactive review of all merges since LiteLLM epic shipped.
* Bug b38d-1781-ef5a-41af (P0): LiteLLM integration shipped without functional CI review.
* Bug d99c-f4d4 (P0): ModuleNotFoundError on dso_ci_review/dispatch.py.
* Bug fcea-6e83 (P0): llm-review CI job exits 0 on ModuleNotFoundError.

comments.body: INVESTIGATION: This bug requires retroactive LLM code review of PRs #49 onward. No automated code fix is applicable — this is a human-coordination action item. Each affected PR must be individually reviewed via /dso:review and critical/important findings remediated. Bug remains open until retroactive reviews are complete.

comments.body: Investigation complete (debug-everything 2026-05-11): Confirmed — b38d-1781 (litellm ModuleNotFoundError) and related P0 bugs are already closed in this repo (per prior debug-everything session). The current CI review gate is functional. Retroactive review of PRs merged while the gate was broken (PR #49+) requires human-guided retroactive review sessions — cannot be fully automated in a single debug-everything run. Scope: check each PR from #49 to current for unreviewed code; run /dso:review on any that lack a passing review. Recommend creating a dedicated sprint for retroactive review coverage rather than attempting in debug-everything.
